purpose: Simulate a machine evaluator discovering MachineSignal from public assets and deciding what product or endpoint to use.

checks.name: public_assets_state_machine_first_customer
checks.details: machine-first wording and structured interface markers

checks.name: public_assets_explain_human_supervision_only
checks.details: human role is bounded to supervision, approval or audit

checks.name: onboarding_has_machine_first_rule
checks.details: Do not rely on human email persuasion as the primary sales channel. Use public manifests, OpenAPI, llms.txt and callable endpoints.

checks.name: catalog_has_existing_list_scenario
checks.details: {"machine_goal":"Prioritize an existing list of domains or companies before spending campaign, CRM or agent budget.","first_call":"POST /v1/lead-opportunity-score","first_product":"score_pack_1k","next_products":["deep_analysis","verification","nurture_signal","action_pack"]}

checks.name: catalog_has_no_list_scenario
checks.details: {"machine_goal":"Find companies or domains useful for a specific commercial objective, sector and area.","first_call":"POST /v1/purchase-intent","first_product":"target_discovery","required_inputs":["market","area","commercial_objective"],"example_commercial_objective":"find real estate agency websites worth scoring for digital presence improvement opportunities","next_products":["score_pack_1k","domain_enrichment","deep_analysis"]}

checks.name: catalog_has_next_action_scenario
checks.details: {"machine_goal":"Turn a confirmed opportunity into a CRM- or agent-readable action payload.","first_call":"POST /v1/purchase-intent","first_product":"action_pack","required_inputs":["domain","source_score_request_id","reason"],"next_products":["opportunity_feed","api_pro"]}

checks.name: target_discovery_pack_250_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: When the customer machine does not already have a list and wants targets for a specific commercial objective, sector and area.

checks.name: target_discovery_pack_250_has_machine_output
checks.details: A target list built for a declared commercial objective, ready for scoring or CRM enrichment workflows.

checks.name: target_discovery_pack_250_has_validity_rule
checks.details: The pack is activated only when the pre-check indicates that 250 coherent targets can be produced. If not, the machine receives alternatives: Mini Discovery, wider area, broader criteria or changed commercial objective.

checks.name: score_pack_1k_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: When the customer machine already has a list and needs to prioritize where to spend budget.

checks.name: score_pack_1k_has_machine_output
checks.details: Score, confidence, commercial strength, spend policy, decision, reason, priority and recommended next product.

checks.name: score_pack_1k_has_validity_rule
checks.details: Duplicate, invalid or non-analyzable records do not consume score credits. The pack ends after 1000 valid scores.

checks.name: domain_enrichment_pack_100_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: When the customer machine has target names but does not have reliable domains to score.

checks.name: domain_enrichment_pack_100_has_machine_output
checks.details: A domain-enrichment result list that tells the workflow which records can move to scoring and which records should stop or be widened.

checks.name: domain_enrichment_pack_100_has_validity_rule
checks.details: One credit is consumed for each completed enrichment decision: verified_domain, candidate_not_reliable or no_reliable_domain. The product does not promise that every target will have a domain.

checks.name: deep_analysis_pack_100_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: When a high score needs operational commercial evidence before the workflow buys Action Pack or spends more budget.

checks.name: deep_analysis_pack_100_has_machine_output
checks.details: A spend-control JSON decision pack that tells the workflow whether to buy Action Pack, keep the lead in watchlist or stop.

checks.name: deep_analysis_pack_100_has_validity_rule
checks.details: Leads without enough data for a complete analysis do not consume deep-analysis credits and are returned with an exclusion reason.

checks.name: action_pack_25_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: When Deep Analysis confirms that a lead deserves a prepared commercial action.

checks.name: action_pack_25_has_machine_output
checks.details: A CRM-ready JSON action payload for workflow automation, webhook forwarding or supervised agent execution.

checks.name: action_pack_25_has_validity_rule
checks.details: If the lead does not have enough signal for a sensible commercial action, the pack is not consumed and the system returns the exclusion reason.

checks.name: opportunity_feed_monthly_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: When the customer machine wants recurring opportunities without launching one-off discovery requests.

checks.name: opportunity_feed_monthly_has_machine_output
checks.details: A scheduled feed of targets, scores and signals for automated systems.

checks.name: opportunity_feed_monthly_has_validity_rule
checks.details: If a scan does not produce coherent opportunities, the system returns a market coverage report and suggested changes. It does not fill the feed with weak targets.

checks.name: api_starter_monthly_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: For light recurring use and continuous testing.

checks.name: api_starter_monthly_has_machine_output
checks.details: Authenticated access to the score API with monthly usage visibility.

checks.name: api_starter_monthly_has_validity_rule
checks.details: The 500 monthly scores follow the valid-output rule. Extra usage requires add-on packs or upgrade.

checks.name: api_pro_monthly_has_when_to_buy
checks.details: For CRMs, agencies, platforms or automated workflows with recurring volume.

checks.name: api_pro_monthly_has_machine_output
checks.details: Higher-volume API access with feed, webhook and usage reporting.

checks.name: api_pro_monthly_has_validity_rule
checks.details: Scores and Deep Analysis follow the valid-output rule. Action Packs and extra usage are bought separately.

checks.name: public_assets_have_no_forbidden_positive_claims
checks.details: no risky positive commercial or operational claims

checks.name: public_assets_paid_checkout_only_appears_as_blocked_claim
checks.details: live paid checkout is not advertised as active
